== Notes ==
* All other Water Magic skills that reduce the movement speed of multiple targets have a significantly shorter duration than Deep Freeze even on high Water Magic ranks. As such, Deep Freeze can be used effectively to hinder enemy movement even without any investment in Water Magic.
